name: Bridge (Cards) Club
description: The Mallacoota bridge club folded for lack of interest. Colin Dixon will start a weekly game if three other people want one, so this listing is here to find them rather than to describe something already running. He also has two Bridge+More dealing machines, bought in 2021 and barely used since: they deal real cards, run barometer scoring and play the hand back for analysis afterwards, and he lends them out and demonstrates them for free.
descriptionShort: Folded for lack of interest. Three more players and it starts again.
notes_seasonal: Not running at the moment. If you would play weekly, say so: three people is the whole difference between this and a game.

trading.note: Folded for lack of interest. Three more players who want a weekly game and it starts again - ring or email.
